lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters distributed across the mid-lateral flank, though individual centroids exhibit significant horizontal motion blur.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersecting with the horizontal blob rows to create a non-uniform grid pattern across the mid-posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge along the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, separating the dorsal region from the mid-flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, elongated, high-luminance object (remora) attached to the mid-flank superior to the pectoral fin.
